name: Adoram
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy

points: Solomon raises a levy out of all Israel of thirty thousand men and sends them to Lebanon ten thousand a month by course, a month in Lebanon and two months at home. A levy here is an enlistment for service, the men gathered to bring the wood back to Jerusalem, and Adoniram was over the levy.

note.label: 1 Kings 5: Solomon Makes a League with Hiram to Build the House

points: King Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over the tribute, and all Israel stoned him with stones, that he died., you came in to collect money? We ain't giving you nothing. And Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot to flee to Jerusalem; he said, they going to kill me next. So Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.

note.label: Raising Up the Tabernacle of David That Fell

points: Rehoboam sent Adoram who was over the tribute, and all Israel stoned him with stones, so the king fled in his chariot to Jerusalem. This is the split, the northern tribes rebelling against the house of David until this day.

note.label: 1 Kings 12: The Kingdom Divided Under Rehoboam and Jeroboam

points: Rehoboam still reigns over the children of Israel who dwell in the cities of Judah, but when he sends Hadoram over the tribute, Israel stones him to death.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 10: Rehoboam Rejects the Elders and the Kingdom Divides
